taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-14, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 161.1 | 3.39 | 3.39
2 | 1022.2 | 1.76 | 5.15
3 | 85.2 | 1.93 | 7.08
4 | 88.8 | 9.77 | 16.85
5 | 117.4 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve type, we analyze the resistivity of each group of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Layer 1-2-3**:
    Resistivities: $r_1 = 161.1$, $r_2 = 1022.2$, $r_3 = 85.2$
    Comparison: $161.1 < 1022.2$ and $1022.2 > 85.2$ ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3$).
    According to the rule, this corresponds to the letter **K**.

2.  **Layer 2-3-4**:
    Resistivities: $r_2 = 1022.2$, $r_3 = 85.2$, $r_4 = 88.8$
    Comparison: $1022.2 > 85.2$ and $85.2 < 88.8$ ($r_2 > r_3 < r_4$).
    According to the rule, this corresponds to the letter **H**.

3.  **Layer 3-4-5**:
    Resistivities: $r_3 = 85.2$, $r_4 = 88.8$, $r_5 = 117.4$
    Comparison: $85.2 < 88.8$ and $88.8 < 117.4$ ($r_3 < r_4 < r_5$).
    According to the rule, this corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining these letters in depth order, we get **KHA**.

{"curve_type": "KHA"}
